title: z-ui.json
description: Written by `z-ui init` into a consumer project. Each alias carries both the import specifier and the disk path explicitly, which is what keeps tsconfig path resolution out of the CLI entirely.

registry.description: Base URL or local filesystem path. A local path is how contributors test uncommitted components and how the CLI test suite runs without network.

path.description: Directory on disk relative to the project root, e.g. "src/components/z-ui".
